waves.name: Source Ingestion & Style Extraction
waves.claim: Both real QCELL/RFCELL SVGs ingested; every drawable element extracted with correct inline-style colour precedence (style wins over attribute).
known_gaps: One degenerate transform produces an x-coordinate outlier (~6.9M); mitigated by using viewBox bounds for all extent/quadrant math rather than raw element coords.

waves.name: Colour Line Decomposition & Validation
waves.claim: Every drawable element clustered to nearest canonical colour anchor by RGB distance; seven per-colour process-line files emitted; unmapped reduced.
known_gaps: 112 elements remain unmapped (flagged 'unknown', not deleted) — mostly magenta/other off-legend colours.
Colour is treated as primary line identity; cross-validation against tag/ISA class is documented but NOT yet automated (see AGENTS.md Governance 3).

waves.name: Layer / Mechanical-Section Engine
waves.claim: Every colour line and element assigned to a layer in a 13 top-level / 21 named sub-layer hierarchy; assignment is exhaustive (sum-check balances).

layer_sum_check.note: drawable + text = total, no drops or double-counts. Atlas in-place annotation reports 2425 = 1834 QCELL + 591 RFCELL; the +4 vs 2421 is group-wrapper elements (documented, honest).

known_gaps: Layer ids are a stability contract (never rename id; use aliases map in configs/layers.yaml). Renames would break downstream references.

waves.name: Geometry, Arrow Tracing & Sequential Ordering
waves.claim: Geometric pairing of text/dots/triangles/arrows to lines; flow topology from arrows + junctions; spec dots catalogued.
known_gaps: 77 elements remain floating (unmatched to any line) — flagged, not deleted.

Pairing max distance 1040.2px on a 1527px-wide canvas is almost certainly a wrong pairing; pairs above ~355px (p90) are flagged LOW-CONFIDENCE in the combined report and must not be trusted as ground truth.
Sequential ordering uses arrow + left-to-right evidence only; lines without arrow evidence keep extraction order (not re-ordered).

waves.name: Tag & Instrument Register Reconciliation (XLSX coverage delta)
waves.claim: Cross-reference the auto-catalogued as-drawn instrument tags against the official design nomenclature register; quantify per-tag and per-TYPE coverage delta (matched/missing/extra), cross-validate against ISA classes, and apply documented PPT re-allocations.
known_gaps: Exact tag overlap is 0: design (circuit-sequential CV001/TT100...) and as-drawn (SVG-instance CV560/TT514...) numbering schemes are orthogonal. A design<->as-drawn engineering cross-map is required for tag-level reconciliation; coverage is therefore reported per instrument TYPE.
10 design instrument TYPES (FT, FV, HX, J, LE, LI, PV, RD, SV, V) are not represented in the as-drawn catalog because the W003/W004 category sheets covered only CV/EH/HV/LS/PT/TT.

The 65 MB QSYS instrumentation PPT was not exhaustively machine-parsed (cost); only the two explicitly documented re-allocations (TT535 -> PZ coldest, TT525 -> PZ warmest) are encoded with citations. TT525 is absent from the as-drawn catalog.
24 RFCELL template placeholders (tags containing a literal x, e.g. TTxxx/EHx11) are flagged non-reconcilable rather than matched.
